scenes.title: Previously on The Producers
scenes.summary: A brief recap revisits Seung-chan's hectic first day at KBS, Ye-jin scratching his father's sedan, and Joon-mo learning his cast will be replaced.

scenes.title: Four Months Without an Apartment
scenes.summary: Joon-mo recalls how his mother bought Ye-jin's childhood flat in Yeouido; years later over drinks, Ye-jin vents that her lease ends four months before her new flat opens.

scenes.title: A Thumbprint Pledge and an Unspoken Cut
scenes.summary: Ye-jin moves her bags into Joon-mo's flat with a drunken thumbprint pledge for free lodging, then asks how Youn Yuh-jung reacted to leaving the show before Joon-mo admits he has not told her yet.

scenes.title: Studying Slapstick Comedy History
scenes.summary: At home before receiving his program assignment, Seung-chan studies classic Korean comedy tapes and earnestly compares famous slapstick characters for the documentary camera.

scenes.title: Running Into Hye-joo Outside Home
scenes.summary: While taking out the recycling, Seung-chan runs into Shin Hye-joo, who cheerfully mentions she is visiting her boyfriend Joon-mo nearby and urges Seung-chan to join Entertainment Weekly.

scenes.title: Draw a Clear Line
scenes.summary: After Hye-joo leaves, Ye-jin scolds Joon-mo for sending vague text messages instead of ending things politely, while Joon-mo complains that his privacy is gone.

scenes.title: Charging Properly for the Car Scratch
scenes.summary: Ye-jin wonders whether the rookie's father will really bill her for scratching his car, while Seung-chan's father insists on charging properly and asks Seung-chan to air a friend's bakery grievance.
scenes.location: Joon-mo's flat and Baek family dining room

scenes.title: Assigned to 2 Days and 1 Night
scenes.summary: Chief producer Kim Tae-ho praises Seung-chan for picking Entertainment Weekly as his first choice, then promptly assigns him to Joon-mo's struggling outdoor variety team instead.

scenes.title: Rookie Seung-chan's Honest Idea
scenes.summary: Asked at his first team meeting how to break the cast-change news, Seung-chan suggests gathering the actresses and telling them honestly, earning a scoff from Joon-mo and an errand for printer toner.

scenes.title: Seating Charts and Shaking the Toner
scenes.summary: Turned away at the supply desk, Seung-chan returns as Ji-yeon and Joon-mo debate wrap-party seating order and catch Seung-chan obediently shaking the empty toner cartridge.
scenes.location: supply desk and 2 Days & 1 Night room

scenes.title: Toner Diplomacy and the Repair Quote
scenes.summary: Seung-chan watches in awe as Ye-jin flatters the supply chief into handing over fresh toner, then tells Ye-jin in the stairwell that his father's car repair estimate came to eight hundred thirty thousand won.

scenes.title: Where Is Your Agency Boss?
scenes.summary: Ye-jin presses Cindy's manager over why his agency president suddenly flew to South America after Cindy's stage stunt, while Cindy coolly brushes off the station's reaction.
scenes.location: Music Bank meeting room and agency office

scenes.title: Secret Delivery Advice at the Agency
scenes.summary: At her agency, Cindy quietly tips off hungry trainees about the side door with no security camera, then answers her former groupmates' complaints before heading out to her broadcast.
scenes.location: agency practice room and meeting room

scenes.title: Youn Yuh-jung Treats the Team
scenes.summary: Just as Joon-mo and his staff argue that none of them can tell Youn Yuh-jung she is off the show, the veteran actress drops by with her card for coffee and praises variety television.

scenes.title: Losing Favour Takes One Moment
scenes.summary: Joon-mo begs Tae-ho to help him transfer to an indoor studio show before rainy season; Tae-ho quotes a poem about how fast a boss's favour fades right before Director Jang catches him.

scenes.title: Sending the Five-Hour Rookie
scenes.summary: Listing all the traits needed to break the cast-change news gently to Youn Yuh-jung, Joon-mo selects Seung-chan, who joined the team only five hours earlier.

scenes.title: Too Polite to Be Understood
scenes.summary: Seung-chan phrases the departure notice to Youn Yuh-jung so indirectly that she assumes the show is making her its main star, promises to work harder, and drops him on the roadside.
scenes.location: salon lobby and Youn Yuh-jung's van

scenes.title: Checking on the Messengers
scenes.summary: Stranded on the street without his seniors' numbers, Seung-chan looks up the station directory while Joon-mo finishes his own cast talk and assumes everyone delivered the news.

scenes.title: Sold-Out Cake at the Wrap Dinner
scenes.summary: At the dinner restaurant, the actresses save face over leaving until Youn Yuh-jung arrives in high spirits, touched by the popular cake Joon-mo bought and still believing she will stay on the show.
scenes.location: private room at a Korean restaurant

scenes.title: The Secret Breaks at Dinner
scenes.summary: While Seung-chan urgently calls Ye-jin for a writer's phone number, Tae-ho bursts into the dinner bragging that he protested the cast cut, revealing to a stunned Youn Yuh-jung that the show is ending.

scenes.title: Are We Dolphins?
scenes.summary: After Youn Yuh-jung rebukes Joon-mo for sending a rookie to handle her departure, Joon-mo explodes at Seung-chan for speaking in riddles and tells him never to appear before him again.

scenes.title: Ending Things Politely
scenes.summary: Stepping outside the noisy restaurant, Joon-mo takes Ye-jin's advice to heart and tells Hye-joo plainly and politely that they should stop meeting privately.

scenes.title: Alone at the Variety Desk
scenes.summary: Sitting dejectedly in the office instead of attending his welcome party, Seung-chan gets encouragement from Il-yong and practical advice on logging overtime pay.

scenes.title: Homemade Plum Tea and a Warm Goodbye
scenes.summary: Youn Yuh-jung phones Joon-mo's desk about the homemade plum tea she left behind, asks Seung-chan to tell Joon-mo she had fun, and learns the rookie's name before wishing him well.

scenes.title: A Borrowed KBS Umbrella
scenes.summary: Caught in sudden rain at the KBS entrance, Cindy accepts a lobby umbrella from Seung-chan, who earnestly asks for her number only so its cost will not come out of his paycheque.
scenes.location: KBS main entrance in the rain

scenes.title: Two Mistakes Left on Probation
scenes.summary: At the rookie welcome party, Tae-ho cheers Seung-chan up over drinks while Ye-jin hears there is no further car-repair discount and warns him he has two strikes left on probation.

scenes.title: Plum Tea and the Roommate Pledge
scenes.summary: Seung-chan hands Joon-mo Youn Yuh-jung's plum tea without daring to speak first, and in a flashback Joon-mo stamps his thumbprint onto Ye-jin's housing pledge so she will not stay in a motel.
scenes.location: KBS editing room and neighbourhood pub
